question:
암 관련 피로(Cancer-Related Fatigue, CRF)의 중재 효과를 평가하기 위해 주로 사용되는 표준화된 척도는 무엇인가?  
1) Beck Depression Inventory (BDI) 
2) Functional Assessment of Cancer Therapy: Fatigue (FACT-F) 
3) Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI) 
4) Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale (HADS) 
5) Visual Analogue Scale (VAS)
answer: 2) Functional Assessment of Cancer Therapy: Fatigue (FACT-F)
